summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of DM Notebook / DM Lessons feature. All 20 backend pytest cases passed (CRUD, character scoping, LLM reaction distillation, DM feedback distillation, lesson injection apply_count bump, Jaccard merge). Frontend ESC pause menu shows new 'DM Notebook' option which opens DMNotebookPanel rendering all 4 grouped sections with weight stars, toggle/edit/delete/+−/manual-add controls, source attribution and apply_count badges. 👍/👎 buttons present on every DM narration beat.
critical_code_review_comments: merge_or_create_lesson treats apply_count>0 as proxy for merge action, but a freshly-merged lesson and an inserted lesson whose apply_count was later bumped by /dm/action are indistinguishable in the reaction endpoint response. Acceptable for now, but consider returning an explicit 'merged'/'created' flag from merge_or_create_lesson for stricter API contract.

distill_lesson_from_feedback: when judgment.agrees_with_player is False AND kind is missed_check/wrong_check, code falls through to compose a text using check_type/dc from judgment that may be None, producing somewhat noisy lessons ('Player flagged: ... Reasoning: '). Minor.
Reaction endpoint runs synchronous LLM call inside the request (no background task). p95 latency ~3-8s on each 👍/👎. Consider background distillation with optimistic UI on the frontend.
load_active_lessons sort is (weight desc, created_at desc) but list_lessons sort is (enabled desc, weight desc, created_at desc). Two sources of truth for ordering — fine, but document or unify.
test_credentials: No auth required. Used existing campaign_id=29feef57-a81d-4799-a988-88d644406acc, character_id=69fc667f579c1db376ac58db. No /app/memory/test_credentials.md found (flagged).
seed_data_creation: Created manual lessons prefixed TEST_ManualA / TEST_CharB and cleaned them up post-test. The DM-feedback-distilled Stealth lesson (sneak/past/grab/locket) persists in the campaign as part of normal feature behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_dm_lessons.py and uses real LLM calls (Emergent LLM key, gpt-4o-mini). Tests use module-scoped state (pytest.lesson_a_id etc) — must be run as a full file, not single test. Frontend testid map: escape-menu-dm-notebook-btn opens dm-notebook-panel containing dm-notebook-group-{rule_correction|dc_calibration|taboo|style_preference}. Each lesson row uses dm-lesson-{id} root with dm-lesson-toggle/delete/edit-btn/weight-up/weight-down/edit/save-btn-{id} children. Beat reactions: beat-like-{idx} / beat-dislike-{idx}.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. One self-corrected test issue: initial /dm/action body used 'action_text' but endpoint expects 'player_action' — fixed in test file.
